concepts_in_source_text_not_in_dataset: תפילה — prayer; the central concept, presented as the universal means to reach all spiritual goods
תורה — Torah study; one of the goals reachable through prayer (eitza target, not bechina)
עבודה — divine service; one of the goals reachable through prayer (eitza target, not bechina)
קדושה — holiness; the general domain of all things attainable through prayer
התקרבות להשם יתברך — drawing close to God; the overarching question that prompted the teaching
analysis_notes.note: All concept-relationships in this teaching are causal (eitza): 'על ידי תפילה יכולין לבוא לכל' — through prayer one can come to Torah, avoda, kedusha. The 'על ידי...לבוא ל' construction is directional cause-and-effect. There are no bechina identifications (no 'X הוא בחינת Y' language). The second part about the dead person praying is a motivational mashal, not a conceptual identification. No bechina additions are warranted.
